interface.signature: def longestSubstring(N: int, S: str) -> str:

preconditions.description: The input integer N must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The length of string S must exactly equal the input integer N.
The string S must consist only of alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: result == -1 or (len(result) >= 1 and all(c.isalpha() for c in result))
postconditions.description: The result must be either -1 or a non-empty alphabetic substring of S.
If the result is not -1, it must be a substring of S that appears at least twice without overlapping.

postconditions.expression: result == -1 or all(len(result) >= len(candidate) for candidate in [S[i:j] for i in range(N) for j in range(i+1, N+1) if S.find(S[i:j]) != -1 and S.find(S[i:j], S.find(S[i:j]) + 1) != -1])
postconditions.description: If the result is not -1, it must be the longest substring of S that appears at least twice without overlapping.
If the result is not -1 and there are multiple substrings of the same maximum length, the one that appears first in S must be chosen.
